title: Meta Platforms, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-14
summary: Meta Platforms filed an 8-K on April 14, 2026 disclosing that board directors Hock E. Tan and Tracey T. Travis notified the company they will not stand for re-election at the 2026 Annual Meeting. They will continue serving until the meeting date.
key_points: Hock E. Tan and Tracey T. Travis will not stand for re-election to Meta's Board at the 2026 Annual Meeting
Both directors will continue serving until the Annual Meeting date
Filing is pursuant to Item 5.02 (Departure of Directors or Certain Officers)
Filed by Katherine R. Kelly, Vice President and Corporate Secretary on April 14, 2026
why_it_matters: This is a corporate governance matter. The departure of two board directors, including one with financial expertise (Tracey T. Travis served as CFO of another large public company), may be relevant to investors tracking board composition and oversight at Meta.
